thread:
Nikhil: quick follow-up from the recent postmortem	 we've seen this cache-rotation pattern repeat three times. need owners, jira links, and a clear handoff so items don't linger.
Rae: i'll take investigation ownership (R). creating RWD-9999 for root cause and repro steps. aim to post triage by Thu.
Omar: i'll own remediation & rollout (A). opening RWD-10000 for the patch + canary.
Zoe: i'll be consulted for alerting and runbook updates (C). will draft alerts and a short ops play.
Nikhil: proposed RACI: Rae=R, Omar=A, Zoe=C, Nikhil=I (pm). ok?
Rae: short triage: cache-rotate thrash correlates with long-running batch reads that hold locks during compaction. sample log: ```2026-03-30T23:11:07Z cache-manager warn: rotate_delay_ms=4200 lock_wait_ms=3900```
Rae: steps in RWD-9999: (1) reproduce in perf sandbox (2) add per-operation lock metrics (3) test reduced compaction concurrency.
Omar: mitigation plan RWD-10000: (1) lower compaction concurrency to 2, (2) add backpressure for long reads, (3) canary for 72h on subset.
Zoe: alerting RWD-10001: create warning at rotate_delay>2000ms for 10m, page at >5000ms. will link runbook and escalation path.
Nikhil: gating: no rollout until canary metrics show rotate_delay p95/p99 <= baseline for 48h. add gating to both tickets.
Rae: added gating note to RWD-9999 and linked RWD-10000/10001.
Omar: draft PR up, linking RWD-10000. assigning Rae & Zoe for review.
ops-bot: Created Jira tickets RWD-9999, RWD-10000, RWD-10001 and recurring event "Cache-rotate remediation sync" weekly until closed.
Zoe: please add a short recurrence note to the postmortem doc so oncall sees history.
Nikhil: agreed. also add dependency: do not rollout cluster-wide until storage compaction tuning RWD-9955 is complete.
Rae: will update the postmortem and mark action items assigned. target completion 2026-04-12.
Omar: will own canary and monitor dashboards. ping me if alerts spike.
Zoe: i'll watch alerts during canary and escalate if needed. :eyes:
Nikhil: thanks folks  leaving thread open for updates or blockers.
